overview: Beach Front is a family-run guest house in a Victorian townhouse on Royal Parade, directly across the road from the beach. It has nine en-suite rooms, three looking out to sea and two towards the South Downs. Breakfast is included when you book direct, and the owners sell parking permits for the street outside.
surfTripFit: A small, friendly base directly opposite the beach, with parking permits sorted by the hosts.
